pages.title: New Materials
pages.text: So, you have aquired a fancy $(item)Netherite Pickaxe$() huh? Well there are two new ores to be mined: $(#9866d6)Heliorite$() or $(#005648)Endurium$().

pages.title: An Upgraded Pickaxe
pages.text: One of these two should be your next goal.
With a $(item)Chunk of Heliorite$() and a $(item)Block of Obsidian$() you can create a new alloy: The $(item)Heliorite Ingot$().
A $(item)Endurium Crystal$() or a $(item)End Endurium Ore$() can be $(thing)blasted$() into an $(item)Endurium Ingot$().
